message:
Hi Mike,
I'm happy for your family that David is home with the family. Thanks again for this website about T-Netix because of David and for your stand against this injustice. I haven't commented here for a while because I am still waiting for a final resolution of my formal complaint at the Maryland PSC about this situation. I can tell you for a certainty that I will be victorious in this matter. This company is the biggest fraud there is. I challenge anyone that works for them to say otherwise. For those that work for T-Netix that would dare to respond to me is that you don't know what you are talking about if you are not their legal counsel. I will be represented by my legal counsel.
Thanks again Mike and best wishes to David.
